name: Bököny (Hungary)
description: White field with a red horizontal stripe along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bököny (a crowned red and blue shield with a yellow lion, with a helm and red and blue mantling) above the name BÖKÖNY in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bököny arms with crown, helm and mantling
